frozen_manifest.purpose: Diagnostic attribution of retained startup history widget liveness around cyclic GC; not a p95 or release qualification.
frozen_manifest.method: Weak references to original history widgets; sample live count at readiness and before/after generation-2 GC. Weak-reference scanning perturbs timing; counts indicate widget liveness, not all collected objects. No GC controls, sleeps or model calls.

receipt.method: monotonic time before xdotool launch to first matching sampled native window pixels
limits: Includes xdotool/process launch and sampling overhead
Scripted 1-second cleanup, no provider or model
Shared host without affinity or load isolation
Diagnostic only; six retained attempts per action, no replacement
No physical device/monitor, clipboard, remote, IME, screen reader or human qualification
